# Shared code-tree parity fixture. This file is BYTE-EQUAL in two repos:
#   hermes-agent/tests/fixtures/build_identity/code_tree_parity_tree.txt
#   EterniaLauncher/test/fixtures/build_identity/code_tree_parity_tree.txt
# Each side hashes it with its own implementation of RS-6's code-tree rule and
# pins the SAME digest, so the two implementations cannot drift apart without a
# red on both. Edit one copy and you must edit the other.
#
# Each entry line is <path> then a TAB then <blob>. Blank lines and lines
# starting with # are ignored. The order below is deliberately NOT sorted: the
# rule sorts by the path's UTF-8 bytes, and a fixture that arrived sorted would
# not say so.
